description: Keeping the California Dream in Reach for Working Families. The rising cost of housing, childcare, and transportation is putting too much pressure on families. Chris is fighting to make life more affordable—because nobody should be priced out of the community they call home. From launching a first-time homebuyer program to expanding rent protections and access to childcare, Chris is delivering results. In the Assembly, he’s championing policies that reduce homelessness, build affordable housing, and support working families.
